text.en:
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 432 August 30, 1974
CREATING THE FILIPINO MUSLIMS WELFARE AND RELIEF AGENCY
WHEREAS, the Philippine government has long exerted efforts to uplift the living conditions of Muslim
Filipinos as part of the over-all program of national development;
WHEREAS, the Islamic conference, a confederation of Islamic nations throughout the world, has recognized
these efforts of the Philippine government and has offered to assist in these efforts;
WHEREAS, the Philippine Government welcomes such assistance and believes that maximum benefit can be
obtained from it if handled by one agency exclusively charged to do so;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND, E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by the Constitution do hereby create the Filipino Muslims Welfare and Relief Agency to be
given primary responsibility for the disposition of any assistance extended by the Islamic Conference for the
benefit of the Filipino Muslims.
Chairman: Governor Simeon Datumanong
Co-Chairman: Minister Sergio A. Barrera
Members: Mrs. Liddy Rasul Tañedo, Department of Social Welfare
Gen. Mamarinta Lao, Commanding General, Muslim Brigade
Mr. Bla Sinsuat
Commissioner Hashim Abubakar
Sultan Rasid Lucman, Confederation of Muslim Sultanates
Col. Abdul-Husin A. Uddin (Ret.), Special Program of Assistance for the Rehabilitation of Evacuees.
Dr. Mamitua Saber
Datu Tawakal Pangandaman, Infrastructure Operations Center
Sultan Mahakuttah Kiram
Mrs. Santanina Rasul
Vice Governor Hadji San Amilhasan
The Filipino Muslims Welfare and Relief Agency shall be charged with the following duties and
responsibilities:
1. Identify priority areas for the application of assistance from Islamic Conference.
2. Inform the Islamic Conference, through the Department of Foreign Affairs, of these priority areas and the
type and extent of assistance needed.
3. Coordinate the mobilization of in-country resources needed for the priority areas identified.
4. Utilize the assistance extended by the Islamic Conference in the priority areas identified.
5. Monitor the progress of work in these priority areas.
6. Inform the Islamic Conference, through the Department of Foreign Affairs, of the statutes of relief and
development efforts in these priority areas.
The Presidential Task Force for the Rehabilitation and Development of Muslim Mindanao shall serve as the
secretariat of this Agency.
Done in the City of Manila, this 30th day of August, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-four.
